Hi Samira — great questions and thanks for outlining them clearly. Quick answers up-front, details below:

- SCIM + SAML SSO: Supported in Dedicated and Private. Hosted API supports SAML for auth but does not currently support SCIM provisioning into customer IdPs (workaround: manual sync / API-based provisioning).
- Customer-managed KMS/HSM: Full customer KMS/HSM integration (bring-your-own-key) is available only in Private deployments. Dedicated supports envelope encryption and customer KMS for key wrapping in certain contracts — we'll need to confirm with Security for your use case.
- Logging retention/export: Private gives you the most control (export to your S3 and custom retention). Dedicated can stream logs to your account with configurable retention up to X days (we'll confirm exact limits). Hosted cannot meet 7-year retention in your account.

I'll loop in Neha (security) and Dev (integration) to provide precise constraints and a short checklist. Attaching the one-pager that contrasts Dedicated vs Private for quick reading.

Next step proposal: Dev/Neha to confirm SCIM endpoints and KMS options by EOW; then we schedule a short call with your security team.

Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick follow-up from today's call (deployment constraints) — SCIM / KMS / logging details

Hi all — quick summary from Security & Integrations after coordinating with infra:

1) SCIM/SAML:
- Dedicated: We support SAML for auth and SCIM v2 provisioning on Dedicated clusters. SCIM endpoint is available and can be pointed to your Okta tenant; we'll provide sample mappings and attribute schemas.
- Private: Full support — SCIM/SAML as part of the private control plane.
- Hosted: SAML only; no SCIM provisioning.

2) KMS/HSM:
- Private (VPC/on-prem): Full BYOK with KMS or HSM (KMIP) integrated into the customer environment. Keys never leave customer-managed HSM/KMS; Redwood operates under key-wrapping patterns and never has access to plaintext keys.
- Dedicated: We support KMS key-wrapping where the customer supplies a KMS key in their cloud account (e.g., AWS KMS) for wrapping model artifacts and some disk-level encryption. We do not currently support direct HSM-backed KMIP in Dedicated without a custom integration. If FintechCo requires HSM-backed keys, that drives Private or a Dedicated+custom HSM project (engineering effort + SOW).

3) Logging retention/export:
- Private: Logs (audit, request/response, inference meta) can be streamed to your S3/GCS with full retention under your control for 7+ years.
- Dedicated: We can stream audit and metrics to your account (CloudWatch / S3) — retention is configurable but out-of-the-box retention defaults to 90 days; extended retention to multi-year archives is possible via lifecycle rules in your account. We should surface cost and e-discovery constraints (indexing for fast search over 7 years will increase storage/costs).

Risks & notes:
- If FintechCo needs guaranteed HSM-backed BYOK and logs retained in-customer for 7 years with searchable indices, Private is the straightforward path.
- Dedicated + custom KMS/HSM integration is possible but will require an SOW and timeline (rough estimate 8–12 weeks for KMIP bridge + validation).

Samira — happy to jump on a call with your security team to walk through the technical controls and sample SCIM mappings.

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Security Integrations | Redwood Inference
